records.label: baseline-200000-0
records.query: SELECT to_json(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM provisiond.enrolments e JOIN provisiond.tenants t ON t.id=e.tenant_id WHERE t.status='pending' AND e.expires_at<statement_timestamp()) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM provisiond.operations o WHERE o.status IN ('succeeded','failed') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM provisiond.idempotency_records r WHERE r.resource_kind='operation' AND r.resource_id=o.id AND r.expires_at>statement_timestamp()) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM provisiond.idempotency_records r WHERE r.resource_kind='operation' AND r.resource_id=o.id) OR o.updated_at<statement_timestamp()-$1::bigint*interval '1 second')))::text

records.label: baseline-200000-1
records.query: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_build_object('body',h.body,'expired',h.expired,'retained_until',provisiond.wire_time(h.expires_at)) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(o.id,r.resource_id) AS id,o.tenant_id,o.created_at,v.body,r.expires_at,COALESCE(o.status IN ('succeeded','failed') AND r.expires_at<=statement_timestamp(),false) AS expired FROM provisiond.operations o FULL JOIN (SELECT resource_id,max(expires_at) AS expires_at FROM provisiond.idempotency_records WHERE resource_kind='operation' GROUP BY resource_id) r ON r.resource_id=o.id LEFT JOIN provisiond.operation_views v ON v.id=o.id) h WHERE h.id::text=$2 AND (h.tenant_id=$1 OR (h.tenant_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM provisiond.idempotency_records r WHERE r.resource_kind='operation' AND r.resource_id=h.id AND r.scope_kind='tenant' AND r.scope_id=$1)))),'null'::jsonb)::text
